name: 4000-CLOSE-ACCOUNT
description: This paragraph handles finalizing the process of closing a customer account, executing necessary actions and validations.

algorithm.action: move account status to a variable
algorithm.details: sets a flag or status indicating the account is being closed
calls an external routine or performs a database operation to finalize the closure
verifies the success or failure of the close operation and branches accordingly

sideEffects.description: updates the account record to mark it as closed
commits the changes made for the account closure operation
